title: The Most Useful AI Tool You’ve Never Heard Of
channel: Chris Koerner on The Koerner Office Podcast
promo_conflict: Jay promotes Valoop and its Kickstarter launch; Chris says he is a Valoop user.

stated_problem.quote: saving them time from doing the repetitive task that everybody hates.
stated_problem.speaker: Jay

idea.name: Valoop on-device AI agent
idea.one_liner: Sell personal on-device AI hardware and an agent that observes computer activity and prepares or carries out tasks with user approval.
idea.customer: Individuals, creators, employees and businesses that want help with computer-based work.
idea.offer: AI hardware, agent, memory and model that can observe the user's screen and assist with tasks across connected apps.
idea.revenue_model: Hardware sales; the transcript also mentions a website deposit and Kickstarter launch pricing.

key_quotes.quote: I would describe Valoop as somebody actually working next to you.
It's an AI piece of hardware that watches that watches everything you do and lives with you and you can turn it off at any time or give only give it so many permissions if you think it's too much.
I will do uh scanning on the uh invoice itself and will fill it up in my uh personal Google sheet.
So this is something I will say I don't believe we have seen this anywhere in the tax industry right now and I believe this is a new way of us interacting with AI

claims.claim: Jay says early users report about two hours saved per day.
claims.quote: I think this varies from uh person to person but we ask our early users and we have got a round up which is is approximately two hours per day.

claims.claim: Jay equates that reported daily time saving to almost one working day per week.
claims.quote: So two hours a day that uh translate to almost one working day every week.

claims.claim: Jay says users object to recurring bills from many AI websites.
claims.quote: People don't want a $20 bill that comes from 10 different websites or even 20 different websites every month.

claims.claim: Jay says Valoop's marketing has roughly 200 to 300 Meta ads running.
claims.quote: Right now I have like maybe 200 300 ads running on on on meta and there's no way I personally track how much each ad is doing is generating the cost of every click or or every conversion.

claims.claim: Jay says customers can place a $10 deposit on the website before the Kickstarter launch.
claims.quote: If you see it before September 15th, you can put down $10 deposit at our website and you can enjoy extra rewards and extra cash back.

claims.claim: Jay says $399 is the lowest offer and expects the retail price to be $699.
claims.quote: uh this is the 399 will be the the lowest that we will be ever offering to the market and when come to retail I think our price will be set at 699.

claims.claim: Jay says the current local model can handle agentic tasks of about five to eight steps.
claims.quote: So for the local model for the model that is running inside this little box, you can do agentic task to about uh five to eight steps.

claims.claim: Jay expects future on-device models to handle 20 or 30 steps, and refers to models with 8 billion or fewer parameters.
claims.quote: We are expecting the ondevice model can get up to 20 even 30 steps on long agentic workflows which is currently I don't think it is able for 8 billion or less parameter models to do

claims.claim: Jay predicts the model running on Valoop in three months will be more powerful than the current one.
claims.quote: The model that ball loop can run in 3 months will be much powerful and stronger uh than what we current currently running and I don't think this process is actually slowing down.

acquisition_channels.details: Jay says the company runs ads on Google, Facebook and X.
Website deposits and a Kickstarter launch are mentioned.
Jay says the company will make more content for its community.

ideas.delivery: Customers use the hardware with an app and on-device agent; it observes screen activity and prepares or performs tasks across connected apps, subject to permissions. The company provides the device and model updates.
ideas.other_uk_rules: UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018 are relevant if screen activity, emails or contacts include personal data; monitoring should be transparent and proportionate.
